That is all. “ I'm not a monster. „ ~ Sinatra's famous line. Samantha Redmond, better known as Sinatra, is the main antagonist of the American political thriller series Paradise. She is portrayed by Julianne Nicholson. Contents 1 Biography 1.1 Season 1 1.1.1 Before the Bunker 1.1.2 Present day 1.2 Season 2 2 Personality Biography[] Season 1[] Before the Bunker[] Twelve years before the event, Samantha has recently become the richest woman in the world after successfully selling her tech startup company. She meets her future husband in a bar, and the two hit it off almost immediately, having a lot in common. They eventually get married and have two loving children. One day, Samantha and her family are out shopping at the grocery store, when her son suddenly collapses. The doctors reveal that her son is terminally ill and cannot be saved. Samantha comforts her son in his final moments, even telling him that he can make heaven whatever he wants. When her son tells her about how he would see heaven, she is inspired to create a utopian society in his vision. Samantha forms a close friendship with her psychotherapist, Dr. Gabriela Torabi, who helps her cope with the loss of her son. Sometime later, as the event looms closer and closer, Samantha is further encouraged to create the utopia by a motivational speaker trying to warn as many people as possible about a terrible global disaster in the near future. During this time, she also meets Cal Bradford, a rookie politician and the son of oil baron Kane Bradford, the latter of whom nicknames her "Sinatra," because she appeals to everyone as a leader that people seek in dire times. Present day[] Eventually, the doomsday event arrives, and the world enters a frenzy. Luckily, Sinatra had planned everything as ahead of time as possible. She hired construction workers from around the world to build an underground bunker in Colorado, where people would live an ideal life. Sinatra successfully manages to evacuate tens of thousands of people from the outside world and into the Bunker. Season 2[] TBA Personality[] In the pre-apocalyptic days, Samantha lived a happy, somewhat quiet life, even as a billionaire. She was in the glory days of her marriage to her husband and cherished the time she spent with her two children. However, after the death of her son, she became mentally unstable, and her bright personality seemed to vanish, to the point where she would rarely even smile. On some days, she would wear fedora hats to cover up her awkward hairstyles, earning her the nickname "Sinatra." Community content is available under CC-BY-SA unless otherwise noted.
